dimensions.visibleToModel: Model 是否能看到此 Tool (UI projection)
dimensions.executable: 当前 Permission/Scope/Runtime 状态下能否执行
dimensions.permissionRequired: Tool 声明的 Permission 要求
dimensions.currentGrant: 当前 Subject 对这些 Permission 是否已有 Grant
dimensions.scopeAllowed: 当前 Scope 是否在 Grant 范围内
dimensions.runtimeAvailable: 对应的 Runtime 是否就绪可用

matrix.rule: VisibleToModel ≠ Executable; Visibility 是保守投影; Execution 必须重新检查 Permission
separation: Visibility=True + Permission Granted + Scope OK + Runtime OK → Executable
Visibility=True + Permission Denied → Not Executable (blocked at PermissionGate)
Visibility=True + Scope Denied → Not Executable (blocked at ScopeGate)
Visibility=True + No Grant + ApprovalRequired → Awaiting Approval
Visibility=False → Not model-callable but internal paths may exist (verify reachability)
matrix.criticalInvariant: 即使 Visibility 错误授予模型可见性，执行时 PermissionBroker 必须二次判定；不可仅靠 Visibility 完成授权
